_comment: Solution deployment settings for PlantInventoryManagement. Update all placeholder values before deploying. These values map to Power Platform Environment Variables defined inside the solution.

solution.name: PlantInventoryManagement
solution.description: Manages plant delivery orders and office inventory using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and Microsoft Fabric.

environment_variables.description: The base URL of the target Dataverse environment. Used by Power Automate flows and the Fabric pipeline.
Email address used for low-stock alerts and order notifications sent to the Warehouse team.
Incoming Webhook URL for the Microsoft Teams Notifications channel. Create this in Teams > Channel > Connectors > Incoming Webhook.

connection_references._comment: Authenticate using a Service Principal registered in Azure Entra ID with Dataverse System Administrator role.
Use a shared mailbox or service account to avoid dependency on an individual user's mailbox.
Use a service account or the Power Platform service principal for Teams actions.
